content: If parameter CanIfRxSduId of CanIf_ReadRxPduData() has an invalid value, e.g. not configured to be stored within CanIf via CanIfRxP- duReadData , CanIf shall report development error code CANIF_E_INVALID_RX- PDUID to the Det_ReportError service of the DET, when CanIf_ReadRxPdu- Data() is called.
